basic_info.description: Check out this bright top-floor condo with dynamite southern views located in Nob Hill. The smart layout includes a spacious living/dining area with a fireplace and a balcony with sprawling city views. Whip up meals for your guests in the efficient kitchen with laundry closet and pantry. The bedrooms are off the hall to maximize privacy. A generous primary suite sports another view balcony and the en-suite bath features a walk-in shower. The second BR and bath is across the hall.  Additional features include in-unit washer/dryer, storage and 1-car parking. Building amenities include a common roof deck and a beautiful spacious patio. Just down the block is vibrant Polk Street with Michelin-starred Acquerello, Swan Oyster Depot, Toast and others. Nearby essential stops include Brownies Hardware, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's and LiveFitGym, and for outdoor exercise, LaFayette Park is only 2 blocks away. This is easy city living!
